'''Asset R-27''' was a member of the [[The Shroud's syndicate|intelligence network]] that served the independent operative known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. R-27 served in the [[Republic Army]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]<ref name="State" /> in [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> and erroneously reported to the Shroud that the planet's tectonic instability would lead to its destruction. Not long afterwards, R-27 was unexpectedly reassigned to a frontline posting,<ref name="State" /> and while pursuing a [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Mantellian]] ambassador en route to [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]], R-27's starship was destroyed by what evidence later determined was an Imperial stealth fighter, which piqued the Shroud's curiosity, noting that the attack was deep in Republic space.<ref name="Revanite">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20141022|text=The Revanites' Ascendance}}</ref>
